messages:
Sam: Proposal: add server-side estimator for embeddings "units" and return X-Embed-Units header. Helps mixed-dim payloads where bytes mislead.
Lina: Good idea. How do we compute 'units'? Rough formula?
Sam: Cheap ingress estimate: units = N_vectors * a + sum(dims) * b + constant. Tunable coeffs, we store raw dims histogram in telemetry.
Ajay: Concern: SDK auto-splitters will make N requests per logical call. How does Console present one action vs many requests?
Sam: Add split_group_id header when SDK splits so Console can aggregate. Also telemetry will include split_count.
Marta: Ops: telemetry must NOT include vectors. Only send {tenant, route, total_vectors, dims_histogram, estimated_units, split_count}. Sample heavy payloads.
Lina: UX: send advisory 413 with JSON {"reason":"units_exceeded","estimate":"150u","limit":"100u","suggestion":"split smaller or upgrade"}. Console maps units to cost estimate.
Ajay: SDK change: opt-in via X-Embed-Estimate:1 header; return X-Embed-Units. We'll add tests for mixed dims and splitting.
Sam: Rollout: compute units always, but emit header only for canary tenants first (10% for 14d). Shadow accounting for 2 billing cycles before any quota change.
Marta: Alerts: add alert for split_retry_rate>5% and units > 5x route median. Ops will prepare runbook.
ConsoleBot: schedule: canary window starts 1749990000, ticket CAN-5123 created.
Lina: Console needs cards: median units, p95/p99, split-retry %. Add toggle for customers to opt into units-based accounting.
Ajay: Question: do rate-limiters switch to units or stay bytes? Prefer units but keep conservative mapping initially.
Sam: I'll open runtime PR with estimator + feature flag. Ajay: please PR SDK opt-in next week.
Marta: ack, will prototype telemetry pipeline (kafka light topic, 30d hist retention).
Sam: Thanks. I'll write short RFC with exact coefficients and tests. Closing thread.
